messages.subject: Re: Height measurment error
messages.body_plain:
Hi Filipe
I still have problems with the height tutorial I am using the code below.
The last line i the code gives the following message
> CHM.S <- fieldMask(CHM.R, mask = EX1.RemSoil$mask)# [1] "1 layers available"

Error in .local(x, y, ...) : extents do not overlap

library(FIELDimageR) #load required package
library(raster) #load required package
setwd("C:/Users/mg/Agrolab A S/R&D - Dokumenter/1 Running projects/1219 R imageanalyser/Plant height/Tutorial")
EX1 <- stack("EX1_RGB.tif")
plotRGB(EX1, r = 1, g = 2, b = 3)
EX1.Crop <- fieldCrop(mosaic = EX1) # For heavy images (large, high resolution, etc.) please use: fast.plot=T
EX1.Rotated<-fieldRotate(mosaic = EX1.Crop, theta = 2.3, extentGIS=TRUE)
EX1.RemSoil <- fieldMask(mosaic = EX1.Rotated, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, index = "HUE")
EX1.Shape<-fieldShape(mosaic = EX1.RemSoil,ncols = 14, nrows = 9)

# Uploading files from soil base (EX_DSM0.tif) and vegetative growth (EX_DSM1.tif):
DSM0 <- stack("EX_DSM0.tif")
DSM1 <- stack("EX_DSM1.tif")

# Cropping the image using the previous shape from step 2:
DSM0.C <- fieldCrop(mosaic = DSM0,fieldShape = EX1.Crop)
DSM1.C <- fieldCrop(mosaic = DSM1,fieldShape = EX1.Crop)

# Canopy Height Model (CHM):
DSM0.R <- resample(DSM0.C, DSM1.C)
CHM <- DSM1.C-DSM0.R

# Rotating the image using the same theta from step 3:
CHM.R<-fieldRotate(CHM, theta = 2.3)

# Removing the soil using mask from step 4:
CHM.S <- fieldMask(CHM.R, mask = EX1.RemSoil$mask)

Hope you can help to get this to work
Regards
Martin

messages.subject: Re: Error to remove soil
messages.body_plain:
Hi
Instead of using HUE index for removing soil you could try with a Plant index like GLI or NGRDI cropvalue should probably be around 0,03 if using GLI but you can try with different values
DAA1.RemSoil <- fieldMask(mosaic = DAA1, Red = 1, Green = 2, Blue = 3, index = "NGRDI", cropValue = 0.00, cropAbove = F)
